title: Keller's Band Counting Method
author: Salima Rüdiger
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rbcd2iw
materials: The isolated plasmid sample is divided into 1 µg aliquots to perform the T5 Exonuclease reaction. The concentration was measured with Nanodrop. Each reaction contained: 1 µg DNA 5 µl NEBuffer 4 1 µl T5 Exonuclease fill up to 50 µl with Nuclease-free water Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes. This protocol is based on the protocol of NEB.

steps.title: Isolate Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate the plasmid from bacterial culture using the ZymoPURE™ Plasmid Maxiprep Kit following the Vacuum protocol.

steps.title: Purify Plasmids from T5 Exonuclease
steps.instruction: Purify plasmid samples using the NucleoSpin® Gel and PCR Clean-up kit (Machery-Nagel) according to the PCR clean-up protocol.

substeps.instruction: Sum samples in one column to increase concentration in single samples
Ensure the threshold of 10 µg per column is not exceeded to avoid DNA loss

steps.title: Incubate Plasmids with Chloroquine and Topoisomerase I
steps.instruction: Treat plasmids with varying concentrations of chloroquine and Topoisomerase I.

substeps.instruction: Combine 1 µg pDNA, 2.5 µl Cutsmart chloroquine (0-3 mg/ml concentration, calibrated for pUC19), and Nuclease-free water to a final volume of 24 µl
Add 1 µl of Topoisomerase I to each reaction
Stop the reaction by heating at 65 °C for 20 min

steps.title: Prepare Chloroquine Agarose Gel
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1.2% agarose gel containing chloroquine (calibrated for pUC19 and Peqlab chamber 40-1515).

substeps.instruction: Mix 225 ml 0.5x TBE buffer and 2.7 g agarose
Boil the mixture in the microwave
When the mixture is warm to the touch, add chloroquine to a final concentration of 0 - 8 µg/ml
Pour the fluid gel into the Peqlab 40-1515 chamber

steps.title: Prepare Running Buffer and Run Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Prepare the electrophoresis buffer and run the gel.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1 L of 0.5 TBE buffer containing the same chloroquine concentration as the gel
Once the gel is solid, place the trail into the chamber and pour in the prepared TBE buffer

steps.title: Purify Plasmids from Chloroquine and Topoisomerase I
steps.instruction: Purify plasmid samples using the NucleoSpin® Gel and PCR Clean-up kit (Machery-Nagel) according to the PCR clean-up protocol.

substeps.instruction: Sum similar treated samples into one column to reconcentrate the samples
